CBSE Class 12 Re-evaluation: Jharkhand Student Becomes Topper

Following a re-evaluation of answer scripts for the CBSE Class 12 exams, the merit list has been revised. A student from Jharkhand, Avani, achieved a perfect score of 500/500, becoming the topper. This development highlights the impact of re-evaluation on final results and student rankings.
